title: Vendored build compiles wolfSSL's TLS layer
description: wolfssl-src now compiles internal.c, wolfio.c, keys.c, tls.c and tls13.c (and ocsp/crl/dtls/quic when their defines are set) in full builds, so the TLS crates no longer need a system libwolfssl. The weak SetErrorString stub is now overridden by the real one; its tests were split accordingly.
